PLAN "12-Week Upper-Body Focus for Climber with Shoulder Impingement"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Build upper-body strength and stability without overhead loading"

PHASES
  PHASE "Phase 1: Pain-free Base and Scapular Control" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Scapular Control + Horizontal Pull":
        warmup:
          treadmill_walk 6m
        main straight_sets:
          band_assisted_scapular_retraction 3x12..15 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          incline_push_up_handles 3x8..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          chest_supported_row_neutral_grip 4x8..12 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          cable_external_rotation_0deg 3x12..15 rpe 6 rest 75 seconds
          prone_Y_to_T_on_incline_no_overhead 2x10..12 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          bicep_curl_cable_supinated 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
          triceps_pushdown_neutral 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
        cooldown:
          pec_doorway_gentle 2m
      DAY Thursday training 45m "Scapular Upward Rotation + Horizontal Press":
        warmup:
          bike 6m
        main straight_sets:
          serratus_wall_slide_no_overhead 3x10..12 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          one_arm_cable_row_split_stance 4x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          decline_dumbbell_press_neutral_grip 4x8..10 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          cable_face_pull_low_angle 3x12..15 rpe 6 rest 75 seconds
          side_lying_external_rotation 3x12..15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          hammer_curl_dumbbell 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
          cable_pressdown_ropes 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
        cooldown:
          thoracic_extension_foam_roller 2m
    WEEK 2:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Row Emphasis + Rotator Cuff":
        warmup:
          elliptical 6m
        main straight_sets:
          scapular_push_up_elevated 3x10..12 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          chest_supported_row_neutral_grip 4x10 rpe 7 rest 105 seconds
          incline_push_up_handles 4x8..12 rpe 6..7 rest 90 seconds
          cable_external_rotation_0deg 3x12..15 rpe 6 rest 75 seconds
          low_angle_face_pull 3x12..15 rpe 6 rest 75 seconds
          preacher_curl_machine 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
          triceps_pushdown_bar 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
        cooldown:
          pec_doorway_gentle 2m
      DAY Thursday training 45m "Press Variation + Unilateral Rows":
        warmup:
          bike 6m
        main straight_sets:
          serratus_supine_punch 3x12..15 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          one_arm_cable_row_split_stance 4x10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          decline_dumbbell_press_neutral_grip 4x8..10 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          band_pull_apart_low_to_mid 3x15 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          side_lying_external_rotation 3x12..15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          incline_dumbbell_curl 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
          cable_pressdown_ropes 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
        cooldown:
          thoracic_extension_foam_roller 2m
    WEEK 3:
